jobs.title: Power Studies Engineer (PSCAD) Canada
jobs.description: Location: Canada (Remote) Employment Type: Full-Time Industry: Mission-Critical Facilities, Data Centers Travel: Occasional travel within Canada and the United States, as required by project needs Role Summary Ehvert Mission Critical, a business unit within Salas O'Brien, is seeking a highly experienced Power Studies Engineer to join our team and support the analysis and design of complex electrical power systems for hyperscale and AI data centers across Canada and North America. This is a remote role within an innovative, international engineering firm recognized for its cutting-edge work in mission-critical infrastructure. As a Power Studies Engineer, you will play a key role in evaluating electrical system performance, reliability, and resiliency through advanced power system studies and modeling. You will work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams, utility providers, and project stakeholders to develop solutions for high-density AI and mission-critical facilities where system reliability and uptime are paramount. This role offers the opportunity to work on high-impact projects for global clients in the hyperscale data center market while advancing your career in a dynamic and collaborative environment. What We Offer Experience in a high-tech industry within an international company Opportunity to work on unique, cutting-edge hyperscale and AI data center projects Comprehensive training and professional development opportunities Supportive leadership and a collaborative team environment Career growth and advancement opportunities Competitive salary Comprehensive benefits package, including extended health, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, paid vacation, retirement savings program (where applicable), and other employee benefits Stock ownership / synthetic equity opportunities Flexible remote work environment What You Will Do Perform power system studies including load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash, grounding, power quality, harmonic analysis, transient analysis, and reliability studies. Develop and maintain electrical system models using PSCAD, ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, or similar software platforms. Perform electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies to evaluate system behavior during switching events, faults, utility disturbances, and large load changes. Analyze the impact of high-density AI loads and other mission-critical electrical loads on utility systems, emergency generation, UPS systems, and facility electrical infrastructure. Support utility interconnection studies and coordinate with utility providers regarding service requirements and system performance. Evaluate system reliability, redundancy strategies, contingency scenarios, and overall power system resiliency. Prepare technical reports, engineering calculations, study documentation, and engineering recommendations. Collaborate with electrical design teams on medium-voltage systems, substations, standby generation, UPS systems, mechanical system electrical load characteristics, and utility service infrastructure. Participate in design coordination meetings with clients, consultants, utility providers, and project stakeholders. Support commissioning activities and provide technical expertise during project execution. Review engineering deliverables for technical accuracy, quality, and compliance with applicable industry standards. What We Expect Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electrical Engineering from an accredited university. 8–15 years of experience in power systems engineering, utility engineering, substations, transmission and distribution, industrial facilities, renewable energy, mining, or mission-critical infrastructure. Demonstrated experience performing power system studies, including transient, harmonic, grounding, load flow, short circuit, protective device coordination, and arc flash analysis. Proficiency with PSCAD is required. Experience with ETAP, SKM PowerTools, EasyPower, DIgSILENT PowerFactory, CYME, or similar power system analysis software. Strong understanding of electrical power systems, utility infrastructure, substations, protective relaying, and system reliability. Experience with utility interconnections and medium-voltage power systems. Experience performing underground duct bank ampacity and heat studies (Neher-McGrath methodology) is considered an asset. Registration as a Professional Engineer (P.Eng.) in Canada, or eligibility to obtain registration, is considered an asset. Strong knowledge of the Canadian Electrical Code (CEC), CSA standards, IEEE standards, utility requirements, and applicable provincial electrical regulations. Familiarity with U.S. codes and standards (NEC, NFPA, IEEE) is considered an asset. Excellent technical writing, analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills, with the ability to effectively present technical findings and recommendations to clients. Experience supporting data center, utility, industrial, or other large-scale infrastructure projects is highly desirable. Must be legally authorized to work in Canada. Why Join Us? Work on cutting-edge hyperscale and AI data center projects in one of the world's fastest-growing industries. Collaborate with industry-leading professionals on complex mission-critical infrastructure projects across North America. Enjoy competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and outstanding career development opportunities. Thrive in a collaborative environment that encourages innovation through exposure to advanced power system analysis, utility coordination, digital twins, BIM technologies, computational fluid dynamics, and custom engineering software solutions. How to Apply Interested candidates should submit their resume outlining their relevant experience and qualifications. Join Ehvert Mission Critical , a business unit within Salas O'Brien , and help shape the future of mission-critical infrastructure and next-generation AI data centers across North America. We think of our garden3d as collective for creative people, prioritizing a happy, talented, and diverse studio culture. Our projects range from design-forward websites, to robust web apps, to native mobile development. XXIX  — Design When we started  XXIX  in 2013, we set out to create a different kind of design studio and we’ve thrived because we continually ask what a creative practice can be. We’re building a radically different kind of organization that values autonomy, growth, transparency, and shared responsibility. Index Space  — Community A network of physical spaces all around the world,  Index  provides space for the exchange of knowledge and tools. We nurture trust within the creative community through generosity and abundance of ideas and care. garden3d TK  — Media At garden3d, we’re in the early stages of building an experimental media company exploring emerging themes related to the evolving landscape of technology, design and culture. We aim to monetize this outlet, publish books, produce screenplays, and release music. Plus, our partner organizations https://www.thelightphone.com/ https://www.mill.com/ https://www.ingredient-ai.com/ The Head of Design Role The garden3d Head of Design has one mandate: nothing we put on the internet falls below an 8 out of 10. We are a house of brands - Sanctuary Computer (development), XXIX (design), Index Space (community), USB Club (digital community), and the garden3d umbrella itself - and all of them ship work into the world under our name. Working in close partnership with our founder & president Hugh Francis , this person sets the craft standard, and builds the culture that holds it. You can be based anywhere. A lot of our people are in New York and there's some gravity here, but we already work across timezones and we would happily hire in Europe, Singapore, Chicago, or wherever you are. If you're the right person, we want to hear from you. This role works with studio leads, designers, developers, editors, animators, photographers and clients across every garden3d vertical.  This person can move between a brand identity, a product interface, a case study and a launch film in the same week, and raise the bar on each of them. They span all of garden3d, but their home base is XXIX . Our design studio is where the standard gets set, and where it either holds or slips, so this person runs critique there. Regular reviews. Honest and specific feedback. A shared language for why one thing is better than another, and what practically to do about it. Then they carry that same bar everywhere: to Sanctuary Computer's product and web work, to Index, to new USB Club product launches, to garden3d TK and everything we publish. They are also how we get better people. Our work is only as good as the designers making it, so this person hunts for exceptional talent, sells them on us, and sets them up to do the best work of their careers. The ideal candidate looks at a worker-owned collective with four studios, an open P&L and clients like Google, Figma and The Nobel Prize, and sees a design practice they can propel among the best in the world. Responsibilities & Mandates ‍Quality never less than 8/10 We aspire for 10/10, celebrate 9/10 and never publish anything that’s not an 8/10 - visually, narratively, and in production quality. This person holds that line across every website, brand, deck, film, case study and post, on every vertical. They would rather kill a piece than let a 6 out the door. This person has sat across the table from companies like these, presented work, defended it, and shaped a brand narrative the client's own leadership could repeat back to their board. They can run a room, and they've done it across many industries, not just one. New design business, and the projects that matter most They run new business for design. Pitching, scoping and closing the work we actually want, and building the relationships that bring the next one back. When a project is our highest-profile or highest-budget, they're in it: not always as the day-to-day lead, but as the person shaping the creative direction and making sure it lands. The work we win, and the work we're known for, is the clearest measure of whether this is going well. They’re flexible on anything except conceits that will lower their usually outstanding work quality. They work “smart” by carefully managing their workflow and team. How we interview After you submit your application, a member of our team will reach out. Our interview process starts with an intro call to answer any questions you have about the role and to learn a bit more about your experience and interests. From there, we’ll follow up with a panel interview call where you get to meet a few members of our team, to openly discuss some of our challenges and ensure your skills and interests align with where we’re going as a business. For qualified candidates, the process wraps with a reference call, and an offer to follow. Compensation This is a permanent leadership role. If this individual exceeds expectations in their first four months, we'll shape the permanent role together, with scope and compensation that grow as the studios and their revenue do. After a period of proven success (12 - 24 months), they become eligible to join our worker ownership program. We start with a 4-month fraction trial contract, paid hourly between $110 - $175 p/hr pending seniority & experience. jobs.description: Headquarters: UK URL: https://zapiet.com/ Location: Remote, with a preference for candidates based in the UK Salary: £40,000–£50,000 per year, depending on experience Bonus: Performance-related bonus Reporting to: Chief Marketing Officer and Chief Executive Officer This is a remote role, and we welcome applications from suitably qualified candidates in other locations. However, candidates based in the UK are preferred due to working hours and the need to collaborate closely with Zapiet’s leadership team. About Zapiet Zapiet helps Shopify merchants offer exceptional pickup, delivery and shipping experiences. Our products are used by more than 10,000 merchants around the world, from independent businesses to some of the world’s best-known brands. We are a remote, bootstrapped SaaS company with ambitious plans for the next stage of our growth. We are looking for a commercially focused Head of Marketing to help more merchants discover, adopt and succeed with Zapiet’s products. The role As Head of Marketing, your primary responsibility will be to increase revenue by driving awareness, adoption and continued use of Zapiet’s products. You will turn our wider company and marketing strategy into focused campaigns that generate measurable results. You will own the marketing funnel, from discovery and acquisition through to activation, expansion and retention. You will also manage and grow a team of internal and external specialists across email marketing, SEO, answer engine optimisation, content, communications and other marketing disciplines. This is a hands-on leadership role. You should be comfortable setting strategy, managing specialists, analysing performance and stepping in to help execute when needed. You will work closely with our CMO, CEO, product, sales, partnerships and customer support teams. Your responsibilities Increase product adoption and revenue Develop and deliver marketing plans that increase installations, product adoption and recurring revenue. Identify the biggest opportunities within our acquisition, activation, retention and expansion funnels. Create campaigns that clearly communicate how Zapiet’s products help merchants increase revenue, reduce costs and improve their operations. Increase adoption across Zapiet’s complete product portfolio through cross-selling, product education and lifecycle marketing. Support new product and feature launches with clear positioning, messaging and go-to-market plans. Develop campaigns for specific industries, merchant segments and geographic markets. Turn merchant success stories into compelling case studies, campaigns and sales materials. Own marketing performance Set clear targets and KPIs for every marketing channel. Build reporting that connects marketing activity to installations, qualified opportunities, product adoption and recurring revenue. Monitor performance across the full funnel and identify where merchants are dropping off. Run structured experiments to improve conversion, activation and retention. Manage the marketing budget and allocate resources to the channels producing the strongest commercial results. Report performance, insights and priorities directly to the CMO and CEO. Lead and grow the marketing team Manage and develop a team of specialists across email marketing, SEO, AEO, content and communications. Recruit additional expertise as the marketing function grows. Set clear goals, responsibilities and performance expectations. Create an environment where specialists can do their best work while remaining accountable for measurable outcomes. Coordinate internal team members, agencies, freelancers and technology partners. Ensure campaigns are delivered on time and to a consistently high standard. Strengthen Zapiet’s market position Refine the positioning and messaging of Zapiet and its products. Improve Zapiet’s visibility across search engines, AI answer platforms, industry publications and the wider Shopify ecosystem. Build relationships with Shopify agencies, technology partners, influencers and ecommerce communities. Identify emerging changes in SaaS marketing, ecommerce discovery and merchant buying behaviour. Ensure Zapiet’s communications are clear, distinctive and consistent across every channel. What we are looking for Significant experience marketing SaaS products, ideally within ecommerce, Shopify or B2B software. A proven record of increasing product adoption, recurring revenue or qualified pipeline through marketing. Experience leading and developing a multidisciplinary marketing team. Strong knowledge of lifecycle and email marketing, SEO, content, communications and product marketing. A practical understanding of answer engine optimisation and how AI is changing product discovery. Experience developing and executing go-to-market plans for products and features. Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect marketing activity with commercial results. Experience setting targets, managing budgets and reporting performance to senior leadership. Excellent project management skills and the ability to keep multiple campaigns moving. Native-level written and spoken English, with exceptional attention to detail. A willingness to be hands-on and take ownership of outcomes. You will do well in this role if you Think about revenue and product adoption, not vanity metrics. Can turn a broad strategy into a focused and achievable plan. Understand how acquisition, activation, retention and expansion work together. Are comfortable challenging assumptions and testing new ideas. Know how to lead experts without needing to be the deepest specialist in every discipline. Communicate openly, make decisions using evidence and take responsibility for results. Enjoy working in a fast-moving, international and remote environment. How success will be measured Your performance will be assessed against agreed commercial and marketing targets, which may include: Growth in marketing-attributed recurring revenue. Growth in product installations and qualified merchant opportunities. Improvements in trial-to-paid and install-to-activation conversion. Increased adoption of additional Zapiet products. Growth in organic, email, partner and AI-assisted discovery channels. Merchant retention and expansion revenue. The performance and development of the marketing team. Efficient use of the marketing budget. A performance-related bonus will be paid based on the achievement of agreed targets. What we offer A salary of £40,000–£50,000 per year, depending on experience. A performance-related bonus. Remote and flexible working. The opportunity to shape the marketing strategy of an established, international SaaS company. Direct access to Zapiet’s CMO and CEO. The freedom to build a talented marketing team and introduce new ideas. The opportunity to work with Shopify merchants, agencies and technology partners around the world. Equal opportunities Zapiet welcomes applications from people of all backgrounds. We make hiring decisions based on experience, ability and the contribution each person can make to our team. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/zapiet-head-of-marketing

jobs.title: Temporary US Corporate Relations Specialist
jobs.description: Headquarters: United States URL: https://thehumaneleague.org/ WHO WE ARE The Humane League (THL) is a global nonprofit ending the abuse of animals raised for food. THL fosters a high-energy culture of teamwork and mission-driven problem solving, and we have earned recognition as Top Charity from Animal Charity Evaluators for all of their rating periods. Over the past few years, we’ve grown to a staff of 100+ talented individuals dispersed around the world. At THL, how animals are treated in the food system is at the forefront of our everyday work. We welcome all mission-aligned candidates to apply, no matter where you are in your journey to end the abuse of animals raised for food. YOUR OPPORTUNITY As the Temporary Corporate Relations Specialist, you will play an important role in supporting The Humane League’s efforts to engage with corporations and advance protections for animals in the food supply chain. You are motivated to make a difference in the lives of animals and have the passion to encourage corporate decision makers to do the same. Your primary goal is to support and conduct outreach to bring issues of animal welfare to key decision makers at food companies and their business affiliates. Through research, data-management, and outreach, you will contribute to building relationships and advancing corporate commitments and policies on animal welfare. You will support outreach efforts that increase the number of companies engaged and contribute to measurable progress against corporate commitments, including organizational goals tied to company policy advancement.  In this role, you will work closely with the Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US to support and lead corporate outreach plans, maintain accurate and up-to-date records of engagement, and share insights with the broader team to inform ongoing work while continuing to develop your knowledge of the food industry and corporate engagement strategies.  You are a self-driven communicator who can effectively deliver messages in a professional corporate environment. You are comfortable managing your day-to-day responsibilities independently while seeking guidance on more complex situations and collaborating closely with your team. This role is well-suited for someone who enjoys research, relationship-building, persuasive communication and continuous learning while developing experience in corporate engagement, negotiation support, and advocacy work. This position reports directly to the Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US. This is a temporary full-time, remote position lasting one-year (12 months) in duration, with the possibility of transitioning to a permanent role at The Humane League’s discretion. This role is based in the United States or Canada. To the extent permitted by law, in order to enable collaboration with other global team members, you may be required to work occasional hours outside of 9am - 5pm, depending on your time zone. This position requires domestic and international travel, equivalent to 2 or more trips per year lasting 2 - 4 nights in duration. We will be recording a webinar hosted by Liz Fergus, Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US, Aimee Drugan, Sr. US Corporate Relations Lead, and Debbie Malenke, Sr. Corporate Relations Lead. The webinar recording will be available to watch here by August 13th. Please submit your application by Friday, August 21 at 11:59 p.m. EST . We encourage early applications and will continue accepting submissions while the role is posted on our website. After this date, we will begin advancing candidates and may close the posting early or extend the deadline as needed. If you are experiencing technical issues, please contact careers@thehumaneleague.org . Please submit applications and all supporting documents in English. All application questions and materials need to be submitted here through the application submission form; we do not accept applications through our careers email. CORE RESPONSIBILITIES Execute outreach to decision makers at food companies through email, written materials, phone calls, virtual meetings, and occasional in-person engagement. Support communication of proposed animal welfare measures and contribute to ongoing relationship management with corporate contacts to encourage policy adoption and progress toward existing commitments. Participate in meetings and negotiations with corporate representatives, documenting outcomes and tracking progress toward animal welfare commitments while escalating complex issues to the Sr. Corporate Relations Manager, US as appropriate. Conduct research to identify and verify information on food companies, industry trends, and corporate structures, including hard-to-find information, while evaluating source credibility. Maintain and update CRM systems with accurate, timely data on outreach activities,  contacts, and company progress, and share relevant industry insights with the broader team to inform engagement efforts. jobs.title: Events & Field Marketing Manager
jobs.description: Headquarters: Tallinn, Estonia URL: https://toggl.com/jobs/ We are looking for an  Events & Field Marketing Manager  to own Toggl's presence made physical, the person who turns a conference badge, a booth conversation, or a dinner reservation into real business. The salary for this position is  €70,000   annually , and we are committed to reviewing salaries every year based on company and individual performance. You can work from  anywhere in the world as long as your main location is between UTC-5 and UTC+2.  This role runs events on both sides of the Atlantic, so you'll need to be able to travel to both North America and Europe.   Overview We believe, now more than ever, that in-person moments cut through marketing noise in a way nothing digital can: a handshake, a shared meal, a five-minute conversation where someone finally "gets it." This role is responsible for engineering those moments on purpose, again and again, and ensuring they don't evaporate the second the event ends. You are someone who has done this before (preferably in a B2B SaaS setting) and can negotiate a vendor contract in the morning, rewrite an invitation email by lunch, and walk a trade show floor in the afternoon, reading which conversations are worth a follow-up call.   The role As Events & Field Marketing Manager, you own the full lifecycle of Toggl's in-person and hybrid presence, turning sponsorships, trade shows, and owned experiences into a genuine pipeline engine, not just a brand awareness play. Your main responsibilities will be: Sponsored event execution:  Take full, end-to-end operational coordination ownership for all major external sponsorships and industry trade shows. You'll manage vendor communications, booth layout architecture, graphic dimension configurations, compliance logistics, and swag sourcing & distribution, owning the event budget and negotiating with vendors along the way. Event content & communications : Write and produce all content required to run an event end-to-end — invitations, landing pages, promotional emails, social posts, on-site materials, and post-event follow-up sequences. You'll also create post-event recap content (summary emails, LinkedIn posts, short highlight videos, and case studies where relevant) to extend the life of each event well beyond its final day. Pipeline coordination : Eliminate post-event pipeline latency by building strict cross-departmental SLAs before any event takes place. You'll work directly with Sales and our Demand Gen Manager to build pre-event ad layers, account matching lists, and post-event outbound sequencing so event contacts are in active sales conversations within 24 hours. Owned experiential events : Research, conceptualize, and execute curated physical event touchpoints (think micro-roundtables and private VIP executive dinners) specifically designed for upmarket decision-makers, managing everything from venue negotiation and culinary curation to guest list outreach and on-site execution. Other responsibilities include: Owning the event lead capture process and ensuring all attendee data flows cleanly into HubSpot with correct source attribution. Reporting on cost-per-opportunity for each activation to showcase the impact of event and field marketing activities. Collaborating with Marketing and Sales to align event initiatives with overall pipeline and business goals. Using AI tools extensively in your daily work for research, synthesis, analysis, drafting, and exploration. AI fluency is  not  optional. It's part of how you increase your speed, depth, and impact.   What success looks like Success in this role means every event Toggl touches has a clear plan for turning attendees into pipeline before it even happens. It means vendor logistics and budgets are handled without drama, event content extends the life of each activation for weeks afterward, and no lead ever sits untouched for more than 24 hours. Over time, this role builds a repeatable playbook for events, one where Toggl knows its cost-per-opportunity by activation type and can confidently decide which trade shows, sponsorships, and owned experiences are worth doing again.   About you You will thrive in this role if you: Know exactly how to run events that convert , and you've been doing it for at least 3-5 years. You love bringing new ideas to the table and have experience with event logistics, vendor negotiation, and field marketing strategies. Have run in-person B2B events in the North American market.  You know the conference circuit there, how sponsorship packages get priced and negotiated, which venues and vendors actually deliver, and what North American buyers expect from a booth conversation. Experience in European markets too is a plus, since roughly half the calendar sits here. Are great with people.  The thought of hosting a room full of decision-makers, whether at a trade show booth or an intimate executive dinner, is something that excites you. You know how to make people feel looked after without losing sight of the commercial goal. Are incredibly autonomous (and love it).  You have run successful B2B events and sponsorships in the past and know what works, what doesn't, and what metrics you need to track (major bonus points if you've specifically marketed software before). You can effectively convey how you will build a similarly high-performing events motion at Toggl. Are equal parts operator and creative , but most importantly, you are relentless about follow-through. You know an event is only as good as what happens in the 24 hours after it ends, and you build the systems to make sure nothing falls through the cracks. Want to have fun with marketing.  You will be proactive in bringing new event formats and ideas to the table, finding opportunities for Toggl to show up in the room where it matters most. Are hands-on with AI tools.  You actively use AI for research, analysis, drafting, and prototyping as a core part of how you work, not a side experiment. Don't need to be managed.  You set your own direction, keep people in the loop, and ask for help when it matters. Have excellent written communication skills  and are as comfortable drafting a sharp event invitation as you are briefing Sales on a post-event handoff plan. Asynchronous communication is something you are happy with, and you can concisely express ideas without having to jump on a call.   This Role Is NOT A booth babysitter or a logistics coordinator whose job ends when the stand comes down. A pure brand awareness play where "impressions" and "booth visits" are the headline metric. An order-taker who executes the event list someone else decided on. A role that hands leads to Sales and walks away. A role for people who need heavy process, frequent approvals, or top-down direction to do their best work.   Recruitment Steps Skill Assessment AI-Interview Home assignment Interview with Liz, Head of Marketing Paid Test Week   The Team We are a global team of ~100 awesome people working from over 40 countries around the globe. We hire globally, you work locally—in the heart of London, a beach outside of Río de Janeiro, or a quiet village near Florence, the choice is yours. Every few months we travel to meet up somewhere in the world and spend some quality time together. We place a huge amount of trust in our people, and we measure the outcomes rather than the work itself.  Our values  fuel our results. What's Happening at Toggl Toggl is at an exciting turning point. We're taking our best-in-class time tracking - trusted and loved by millions of users worldwide - and expanding it into something bigger: Toggl Focus. One product that brings together time tracking, planning, capacity management, reporting, and insight. The idea is simple: better time tracking creates better data, which powers everything else. We call it time intelligence.   Benefits Freedom to choose when and how much you work—we only measure results 24 days of paid time off a year, plus your local holidays Unlimited sick leave In-person meetups for team-building (expenses covered) 4-6 weeks paid sabbatical (depending on tenure) Laptop budget up to 2,500€ and it renews every 3 years €2,000 budget to set up your home office and an additional €300 every year after 3 years of tenure €3,000 per year for co-working space membership and/or internet service at home €4,000 per year contribution to use for training, workshops, and conferences €2,400 per year contribution for any equipment or services to improve and/or maintain your physical and mental health Support for buying tools you need for doing your best work (even eyeglasses if you need a new pair) To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/toggl-events-field-marketing-manager

jobs.title: Group Product Manager, Finance Technology
jobs.description: Headquarters: Remote URL: https://redditinc.com/ Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit  www.redditinc.com . About the Role Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity. This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player. This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes. You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when. You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex  finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you.   What You'll Do Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM. As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model. Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap. Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect. Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement. Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation. Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements. Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped. Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions.. Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off. Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business. Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems. Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability. Strategic Orchestration & Influence Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact. Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners. Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies. Lead a rigorous diligence program to evaluate and optimize system performance, workflows, and adoption metrics to strengthen operational quality. Team Leadership Directly manage a team of SaaS product managers, each owning a Finance domain (P2P & R2R, QTC, Payroll & Equity). Set clear direction and priorities for each domain, and create space for deep, high-quality product work. Develop your team's craft through roadmap review, stakeholder coaching, and regular 1:1s focused on growth. Serve as an escalation point and thought partner when your PMs hit ambiguity, contention over priorities, or cross-functional friction. Build the bench: define the team's coverage model, identify gaps, and grow the function as Finance scales. Hands-On Product Ownership:  Maintain direct ownership over a specific set of applications, leading their product roadmaps and managing key stakeholder relationships. This isn't a purely managerial role: you'll run intake, prioritize enhancements, manage releases, and partner directly with Finance and the Eng team to deliver in your own portfolio. Stay close enough to the work to credibly coach your team and make sharp product tradeoffs. Vendor and Demand Management Own Finance SaaS vendor relationships at the portfolio level: renewals, SLAs, roadmap influence, escalations, and spend rationalization. Bring a demand-management mindset to intake; help Finance stakeholders articulate needs, size effort, and sequence work effectively rather than absorbing every request. Partner with Procurement and Finance leadership on tooling spend, contract timing, and consolidation opportunities. Maintain a clear view of total cost of ownership and license utilization across the stack. Stakeholder Partnership Act as the primary product liaison for Finance leadership, translating business requirements into roadmap decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly. Partner with FP&A, Technical Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, Payroll, and Finance Operations to understand pain points and proactively surface system improvements. Work hand-in-glove with the Enterprise Architect and Engineering team to land integrations, data quality, and technical delivery against the product roadmap. Support M&A activity (e.g., systems due diligence, gap analysis, integration sequencing, and adoption planning for acquired entities).   What We're Looking For 8+ years in product management, business/finance systems, or finance transformation, including 2+ years directly managing people. Demonstrated ownership of Finance SaaS platforms across multiple domains (ERP, EPM/CPM, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, treasury, or payroll). Track record of building and running a product/intake operating model: roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, release and change management. Strong vendor management chops: selection, renewals, SLAs, and influencing vendor roadmaps Prior people management experience, with a track record of developing PM or systems-analyst talent. Strong ability to operate across abstraction levels: comfortable in an executive roadmap discussion and in the configuration details of a specific platform. Excellent communication skills: you can frame a portfolio strategy for a CFO and a sprint priority for an engineer in the same afternoon. Strong knowledge of financial controls, audit readiness, SOX requirements, data quality, and compliance impacts. Experience defining close transformation roadmaps, reconciliation strategies, reporting readiness plans, and UAT strategies. Proven success scaling products and owning business outcomes in high-growth, complex environments.   Bonus Points Experience at a high-growth public technology company Familiarity with Reddit's existing Finance tech stack (NetSuite, Workato, Adaptive, Zip, Coupa, Ramp, Workday, Salesforce or comparable) or similar environments Familiarity with advertising platforms and transformation initiatives spanning quote-to-cash or procure-to-pay workflows Experience supporting M&A workstreams (diligence, integration, cutover) Exposure to SOX compliance considerations in finance systems Background partnering with Corporate Engineering or shared-services models   Why This Role, Why Reddit Reddit's Finance organization is scaling rapidly through organic growth, internal investments, and increasing public-company rigor. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Finance technology evolves at a consequential moment: owning the product direction for a portfolio that touches every corner of the company, leading a team, and keeping your own hands on the work. You'll have the autonomy to set direction, the team support to execute, and the organizational access to make product decisions that stick. Pay Transparency: This job posting may span more than one career level. In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit  https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ . To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews. During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us. We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable.  We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes.  We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.  For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our  Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors . Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve.  Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know. Over 75,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 1 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens. We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better. As Senior Manager, Provider Community & Content Marketing, you'll build that community from the ground up: the strategy, the channels, the programming, the events, and the advocate infrastructure that turns a large network into a place where providers feel like they genuinely belong to something. What makes this role distinctive is how we think about content and community together. We believe they're the same engine — great content makes a community feel educated and inspired, and a thriving community unlocks richer, more authentic content. When the flywheel works, providers feel more connected to Headway, and Headway's marketing gets more credible because it comes from real provider voices. You'll build both sides of that loop — and make sure what happens inside the community shows up in how Headway grows. You Will.. Build and define the program – Own the full provider community strategy: define what “community” means at Headway, what it should feel like, what it delivers to providers and how it maps to our goals. Design the full member journey – from newly onboarded provider to active community participant to champion to public advocate – and build the programs, milestones and recognition structures that move providers along that arc. Find where providers want to engage – establish the right mix of community channels, events and experiences based on where providers already go and where conversations are most valuable for Headway to own – evaluate what we’ve built, what’s working and what should evolve Develop the content and programming strategy for each channel – the topics, formats, voices and cadences that make providers feel educated, inspired and connected. Day-to-day management of all community channels – moderate conversations, surface great contributions, carry provider feedback to the right internal owners and create the conditions where participation feels worthwhile. Build a system that identifies true brand champions from participants, and engages them as part of our first ambassador program - that makes top contributors feel seen, celebrated and personally invested in Headway’s success. Harness the power of our brand champions to build a social proof engine, a scalable, systematic process for capturing provider stories, video testimonials, written case studies – and working closely with cross functional partners to amplify across marketing channels, sales motions, etc. Measure constantly: track what drives engagement depth vs. passive consumption, and reallocate toward the content and channels that move providers from audience to participant You’d be a great fit if you.. You've built and scaled a digital community with business results to show for it — not just engagement metrics, but outcomes You've designed and produced events (in-person and virtual) that created genuine belonging and loyalty, not just attendance You've stood up an ambassador or advocacy program and can speak to how you converted fans into advocates and advocates into a growth channel You think of community as a relationship engine and hold yourself accountable to business outcomes, not vanity metrics You believe content and community belong together — and you have strong opinions about format, channel fit, and what's worth a busy professional's time Compensation and Benefits The expected base pay range for this position is $180,000 - $225,000 based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and geographic location. We are committed to offering a comprehensive and competitive total rewards package, including robust health and wellness benefits, retirement savings, and meaningful ownership opportunities through equity. Compensation decisions are made holistically, ensuring fairness and alignment with market benchmarks while recognizing individual contributions and potential. Benefits offered include: Equity compensation Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage HSA / FSA 401K Work-from-home stipend Therapy reimbursement 16-week parental leave for eligible employees Carrot Fertility reimbursement and membership 13 paid holidays + company holiday break Flexible PTO EAP Training and professional development We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. The healthcare experience in America has long been subpar, and the bar for quality design is low — we’re raising that bar, and with it, the entire health insurance industry. As a designer at Thatch, you’ll craft beautiful experiences for the people using our product every day: businesses, their teams, and brokers. You’ll shape all aspects of design, including UI components for our design system, new products involving complex user interactions, and the overall strategy and vision of the design team. Your work will help create a better insurance experience that enables members to get the healthcare benefits they need while feeling calm, fulfilled, and liberated . We’re looking for someone who can meet users where they are in their journey and inspire trust by delivering simple, beautiful, and well-crafted end-to-end experiences. You should be comfortable owning the entire design process, from UX strategy to product design and company branding. What you'll do Participate in and shape every part of the product development process, from idea inception to production Work cross-functionally with engineering, growth, product, sales, operations, and leadership to create incredible user experiences Develop and maintain the design system and brand assets we’ll use across the company Write design documentation and guidelines for internal audiences Iterate on and improve our design standards, tooling, and processes Background we're looking for 4+ years of experience in product design roles Obsession with understanding and serving users and, ultimately, making their lives better Demonstrated first principle thinking and mastery of fundamental design principles Experience operating in ambiguous environments solving complex user problems Ability to balance blue sky creativity and dedication to craft with bias to action Experience we’d be particularly excited about Ability to read and/or write HTML, CSS, and JavaScript Background scaling high growth technology companies in the past Experience or interest in finance, healthcare, or benefits What to expect We want this process to be transparent, thoughtful, and reflective of the work you’ll be doing every day. Our goal is to learn how you think, collaborate, and create — while giving you a clear sense of the team, our culture, and how we work together. Here’s what the process looks like: 30-minute video interview screen to talk through your background and interest in Thatch. 30 minute first-round video interview with the hiring manager to dive deeper into your experience, approach to design, and how you work. 30 minute video meetings to connect with two members of the team 60-minute video meeting portfolio review with members of the design team to walk through your projects, your process, and the impact of your work. 30 minute video meeting with our founder to discuss culture, values, and how we operate as a company. We aim to move efficiently while giving you space to share your thinking, ask questions, and get a real sense of what it’s like to work here.   About Thatch We’re a fully distributed early stage company using technology to change the way America does healthcare. We’re a happy, friendly, high-velocity team. You can read  more on Thatch here . To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/thatch-product-designer

Understanding of 2D animation fundamentals , including shape-based animation and character joints. Basic knowledge of video editing , including timeline management, trimming clips, adding text overlays, and basic audio adjustments. Experience in guiding students through practical, project-based learning activities . Strong communication, mentoring, and classroom engagement skills . Compatible Salary. Flexible Hours. jobs.title: Principal Product Manager (Content Authoring, Delivery & CMS)
jobs.description: Headquarters: DC, District of Columbia, United States Job description Who We Are Great Minds is a high-growth, mission-driven organization founded by educators in 2007. As a for-profit, Public Benefit Corporation, we believe all students deserve access to meaningful, challenging content—and all teachers deserve tools that are intuitive, effective, and built for the realities of today’s classrooms. We develop high-quality, knowledge-rich math, science and ELA curricula grounded in research and designed in collaboration with educators. Our materials reflect real classroom needs and are built to drive lasting student outcomes.   We are committed to usability, coherence, and practical implementation—supporting teachers not just through curriculum, but with professional learning, purposeful technology, and responsive service that enable strong adoption and impact.   What We Build Our products— Eureka Math and Eureka Math², Wit & Wisdom , PhD Science, Geodes , and the newly launched Arts & Letters ELA —are trusted by thousands of schools and districts nationwide. Eureka Math is the most widely used math curriculum in the U.S., and is focused on balancing conceptual understanding, procedural fluency, and application. Wit & Wisdom® and Arts & Letters ELA™ anchor our reading strategy with content-rich, grade-level instruction that integrates literature, history, and the arts, grounded in the science of reading. Geodes® complements our reading suite with decodable texts that pair phonics with meaningful content to support early literacy. PhD Science is a hands-on K-5 Science program that sparks curiosity as students build enduring knowledge of how the scientific world works. These programs reflect a shared belief in high expectations, joyful rigor, and deep respect for educators and students.   Where We’re Headed Great Minds is entering a new stage of growth and product maturity. We are focused on building more connected, customer-informed experiences across the full educator journey—from curriculum to professional learning to platform and support.   Our long-term vision is to become a true partner in impact—not just delivering curriculum, but supporting educators in achieving outcomes at scale. Job Purpose Reporting to the Director, Digital Product Management, the Principal Product Manager (Content Authoring, Delivery & CMS) will lead discovery and execution for our content authoring tools, end user delivery experiences, and content management system (CMS). This role will be critical to how curriculum and assessment content is created, managed, and experienced by teachers, students, administrators, and internal teams. This is a top-level individual contributor role with broad ownership and influence. The position will work with product design, engineering, curriculum, and assessment teams to ensure Great Minds’ authoring and delivery platforms are coherent, scalable, and deeply supportive of high-quality K–12 instructional and assessment experiences. The role will partner closely with Product Design, Engineering, and other teams in and outside the Digital department. Responsibilities Content Authoring Platforms: Define and evolve the product vision for tools used to author curriculum and assessment content. Balance usability for authors with structural rigor required for downstream delivery, analytics, and interoperability. Partner with curriculum and assessment teams to translate instructional intent into scalable software capabilities. End User Content Delivery: In partnership with the Chief Technology Officer, directors, and other leaders, form product strategy for how authored content is delivered to teachers, students, and administrators. Ensure delivery experiences are performant, accessible, intuitive, and instructionally sound. Work closely with Digital Product Design to validate real classroom and instructional workflows. CMS and Content Architecture: Initiate and sometimes facilitate product direction conversations for the CMS, including content models, workflows, permissions, versioning, and publishing—working with but deferring to expert partners in Product Design and Engineering. Ensure the CMS supports multiple products, grade levels, subjects, delivery contexts, and modalities. Partner with Engineering on long-term platform scalability and maintainability. Responsibilities: Set clear product strategy and success metrics for authoring, delivery, and CMS capabilities. Translate complex instructional and operational needs into well-scoped product initiatives. Write clear roadmap proposals and product requirements when they are defined. Collaborate deeply with Product Design to ground decisions in user needs and evidence. Partner with Engineering to make sound trade-offs across speed, quality, and technical health. Influence roadmap priorities in partnership with Product Management and leadership. Act as a subject matter expert on content platforms for Great Minds commercial products. Identify and reduce friction across the content lifecycle—from creation to classroom use. Job requirements 7+ years of product management experience, with senior level ownership of complex platforms or systems Experience building products that serve multiple user types (authors, teachers, students, admins, internal teams) and not exclusively authors Deep understanding of content authoring tools, CMS platforms, and structured content systems Strong systems thinking—able to reason about data models, workflows, and downstream impacts Proven ability to influence without authority and lead through collaboration Comfort working hands on with detailed requirements while maintaining strategic perspective Preferred Qualifications Direct experience with K–12 curriculum and assessment products Required Education Bachelor’s degree Status Full-time Location Remote The expected base salary range for this position is $151,000-$170,000, however the offered salary may be higher or lower than the above range dependent on numerous factors including, but not limited to location, work experience, skills and internal equity considerations. The base salary is not inclusive of benefits or other incentives. A cover letter and resume are required to be considered for this position. New employees will be required to successfully complete a background check. Any communication to applicants relating to the Great Minds hiring process will only come from email addresses with the domains greatminds.org or greatminds.recruitee.com . If in the course of the application or hiring process with Great Minds you are contacted through another domain, are requested to provide banking or other sensitive information, or you note any other suspicious activity, please contact security@greatminds.org Great Minds is an equal opportunity employer. An overview of this role As an AI Transformation Owner at GitLab, you'll shape your function's AI strategy and build the solutions that deliver it. You are the person responsible for identifying where AI can fundamentally change how your org operates, partnering with your Executive Sponsor to align on the biggest challenges, and driving measurable outcomes against them. Think of this as a product management role where the product is your org's way of working. You'll manage the full lifecycle: understanding how work flows today, deciding where AI should reshape it, prioritizing what gets built and in what order, and ensuring what ships actually gets adopted. You'll also prototype solutions, configure agents, and prove what's possible before pulling in engineering support to scale it. You will work closely with an AI Engineer who sits within the Enterprise AI team. Together you form a partnership: you bring the business context, process intelligence, and strategic prioritization. You'll build working solutions at the no-code and low-code layer, and partner with the AI Engineer on the right approach, tooling, and structure. What you'll do Strategy & Prioritization Own your function's AI strategy, aligned with your Executive Sponsor and business priorities. Champions are not your reports: you coordinate them, you don't manage them. Without this network, your reach is capped. Hands-On Building & Agent Operations Build AI agents using no-code and low-code platforms (e.g. Glean, Workato, similar tools). Go from idea to working prototype without waiting for engineering. Configure MCP servers and tools, giving agents access to the business systems they need. Partner with the AI Engineer on what to connect and how to do it securely. Own your function's fleet of agents. Some agents will be used directly by people in your org. Those that aren't, you own. Either way, you're accountable for their performance: tracking KPIs, running evaluations after model or data changes, and iterating based on what you learn. Expect to rebuild. AI tools and models evolve fast. The agent you built last month may need to be replaced, not patched. You should be comfortable sunsetting your own work when a better approach emerges, and helping your org stay current rather than attached to what exists today. What you'll bring Business & Strategic Deep knowledge of your function's operations. You understand how work moves through your org, where it gets stuck, and why. jobs.title: Course Writer and Editor: UX, UI, and AI
jobs.description: Headquarters: Denmark URL: https://ixdf.org/about/careers You're the one people trust with the words, whether you're writing them or fixing them. You noticed that  you loved it, and that you were unusually good at it . You turn rough, complex ideas into words people understand. Now you get the opportunity to work with some of the most respected designers alive, and help share their knowledge with hundreds of thousands of learners around the world. A great hook pulls your readers in, makes them see themselves in the topic, and shows them why it matters in their lives. That's your craft. Abstract ideas don't stay abstract for long, because you find the example that makes an idea concrete. You're structured and systematic, yet creative, and you'll rewrite a sentence six times until it says exactly what you mean. You see the fear around AI, and you understand where it comes from. But you also see the opportunities, and you want to show people how to work with AI in a way that benefits their lives, their users, and the world. If you're also curious about how great design and the responsible use of AI improve people's lives, read on. As one of our Course Writers and Editors, you'll shape how our courses and Master Classes read and flow. The industry leaders whose expertise you'll be turning into courses and Master Classes include  Don Norman and Vitaly Friedman , as well as Design Leads at  Netflix, LinkedIn, Meta, and Adobe . You’ll be involved in all stages of course and Master Class creation, including key decisions, so there are incredible opportunities for you to  take initiative, make meaningful contributions, and grow . Forget political struggles or long, pointless debates. You’ll be in a team with minimal distance between word and action, where decisions are made ultra-fast. Join the Global Leader in Online Design and AI Education IxDF is the world's largest online design and AI education platform, with over 1,150,000 enrollments since 2002. We hold the trust of industry giants like Adobe, NASA, and IBM, who rely on our courses to train their teams. Prestigious universities, including MIT and the University of Cambridge, integrate our material into their curricula. These tasks might touch project management, writing/editing, triaging information, posting on LinkedIn, research, drafting communications and ensuring action is taken. Wider business priorities:  Take on well-scoped work that helps Anna and the Senior Leadership Team move wider company priorities forward. ( Claude , Gemini ) Expert-level Google Sheets / Excel capabilities are mandatory, alongside an operational willingness to manage massive commission infrastructure manually if required. jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager
jobs.description: Headquarters: Brazil URL: http://lawnstarter.com About LawnStarter LawnStarter is the nation's leading on-demand marketplace for lawn care and related services, with over $150M in annual bookings. We're expanding beyond lawn care to become the one-stop shop for all outdoor home services - pest control, pool cleaning, window cleaning, and more. About Engineering at LawnStarter Our engineering team builds the platform that connects hundreds of thousands of homeowners with over 70,000 active service pros. We operate three brands (LawnStarter, Lawn Love, HomeGnome) on shared infrastructure, and we're profitable and growing. Engineering here is fast - we ship constantly, we own our systems end-to-end, and we don't tolerate "not my problem." We have strong processes and existing engineering managers, so you're not building from scratch. You're raising the bar. The Role We're growing, and that means adding engineering leadership capacity to support new initiatives. You'll lead cross-functional delivery teams of 4-5 engineers, reporting to our Head of Engineering. Your job is to make sure your team ships reliably, grows professionally, and doesn't become a bottleneck as LawnStarter scales into new service verticals. This is a people-first role. If your identity as an EM is primarily technical - if you'd rather review architecture than develop an underperformer - this isn't the right fit. If you're the manager who knows what every person on your team needs to grow, who handles conflict directly, and who can articulate team performance in metrics, keep reading. What makes this role different: - You'll own both delivery AND people outcomes - neither can be delegated - Distributed team across time zones, so async leadership and written communication matter as much as meetings - We move fast and actually ship - you'll feel the difference between a team that's humming and one that's stuck - AI-forward is not a buzzword here - we expect you to lead your team on how to use it, not just follow along What You'll Own - People development: Concrete growth plans for every IC on your team - not just the struggling ones. You know where each person is going and what it takes to get there. - Delivery: Your team ships on cadence with predictable quality. You surface risk early, manage scope, and don't miss commitments without warning. - Team health: Conflict gets addressed directly. Underperformers are managed with a clear process. Top performers are protected and developed. - Cross-functional partnership: You're the interface between your team and Product, Design, and other engineering teams. Decisions get made, not stalled. - Technical direction: Close enough to the work to weigh in on system design and catch architectural risks. Not so close that you're in the weeds instead of removing blockers. - AI adoption: You're actively introducing AI tools and workflows into how your team operates - code review, documentation, sprint planning, debugging. You set the pace, not follow it. Problems to Solve Building people leadership depth as the team scales LawnStarter is expanding into new service verticals quickly. That means new headcount, new complexity, and more pressure on EMs to develop the next generation of senior engineers and tech leads - not just ship features. We need an EM who's done this before, not one who's figuring it out. Managing distributed teams without losing culture or accountability Our engineering team spans multiple time zones and countries. Async communication, remote 1:1s, and distributed sprint ceremonies are the norm - not a workaround. An EM who needs daily in-person proximity to lead effectively won't thrive here. Turning delivery consistency into a competitive advantage We have product-market fit and real momentum. The constraint now is shipping reliably enough to compound on that momentum. Your team's velocity and predictability directly affects LawnStarter's ability to launch new services and capture market share. Orchestrating cross-functional delivery from roadmap to release An EM here is the connective tissue between Product, Design, and specialist functions - quality engineering, architecture, and security - from estimation through delivery. The hard part isn't running any one of those conversations well; it's running all of them in parallel without becoming the bottleneck they route through. We need an EM who can hold business value and technical soundness in view at once and make the tradeoff calls - not one who stalls when Product wants speed, Security wants rigor, and Architecture wants the durable answer. Turning AI adoption into throughput without sacrificing craftsmanship We're not experimenting with AI on the margins. Claude Code, spec-driven development, and AI-assisted review are becoming default workflows here - and we track adoption seriously. We need an EM who can turn "the team uses AI" into measurable throughput without letting quality slip, with real opinions about where AI helps and where it quietly creates debt. What Success Looks Like (Year 1) - Every engineer on your team has a documented growth plan within 60 days - and you can speak to it from memory - Your team ships its committed scope on cadence within 90 days - Zero surprise departures - you know your retention risks and are actively working them - Underperformance is addressed directly and documented, not deferred - The Head of Engineering trusts your team's commitments because you've proven they're reliable - Your team is visibly more AI-enabled than when you joined - new tools adopted, old manual tasks automated, engineers unblocked faster Requirements Who You Are Deeply AI-integrated, not just AI-aware. You've gone well past "I use ChatGPT to write emails." Your engineers expect you to bring new AI workflows to the team - you've used Claude to accelerate code review, built prompts that help engineers write sharper tickets, or led your team's adoption of Copilot in the development workflow. When you see a task eating team time, your first instinct is to figure out if AI can handle it. You're actively experimenting, sharing what works, and setting the pace on AI adoption for your team - not following someone else's lead. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your AI usage stops at occasional prompting, if you're still evaluating whether the tools are worth the learning curve, or if you'd describe yourself as "AI-curious" rather than AI-native. A people developer, not just a delivery manager. You can give concrete examples of career growth plans you've built, hard conversations you've had, and underperformers you've managed through a structured process. You spend your 1:1 time on people, not status updates. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your management examples are mostly about process improvements or shipping milestones - or if you tend to blame team outcomes on the engineers rather than the environment you built. Remote-native. You've led full-remote teams before - not just as a workaround during COVID, but as a default. You know how to build trust without shared physical space, how to run async decision-making, and how to keep distributed engineers from feeling isolated. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you haven't managed a fully remote team in a leadership position, or if you feel like remote work is harder than in-person management. Direct in conflict. When there's tension on the team - between engineers, between engineering and product, between a team member's performance and what's expected - you address it directly and quickly. You don't let it simmer. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you've left roles or situations because of unresolved conflict, or if your conflict resolution examples are mostly about "creating space for dialogue" without resolution. Data-driven about people and delivery. You can articulate your team's performance in metrics - not just vibes. You track velocity, retention risk, and IC growth, and you use that data to make decisions. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your answers to performance questions are mostly common-sense observations without examples tied to specific numbers or outcomes. Technically credible. You stay close enough to the code to earn your engineers' respect - code reviews, architectural input, helping debug under pressure. You don't need to be the best engineer in the room, but your team needs to believe you understand what they're doing. This is unlikely to be a good fit if you've fully transitioned to pure management and haven't touched technical work in years. A delegator, not a bottleneck. Your job is to build a team that makes good decisions without you - not to be the person all decisions flow through. You coach engineers toward answers rather than providing them. When you go hands-on, it's deliberate and time-bounded, not a default. This is unlikely to be a good fit if your instinct when a team struggles is to take over, if you find yourself becoming the access point for all requests, or if your team's output goes down when you're unavailable. This Role Is NOT - A pure technical architect role. The team has senior engineers. Your job is to make sure they're effective and growing, not to be the smartest person in every technical conversation. - A process manager. We have processes. Your job isn't to document them better - it's to lead the people running them and improve outcomes. - A stepping stone. We're looking for someone committed to people leadership as their primary craft - not someone who's considering moving back to IC or is ambivalent about managing people vs. building systems. - A reactive firefighter. We want someone who surfaces risk early and manages it proactively - not someone who thrives in chaos and sees every crisis as a badge of honor. - An AI skeptic in a leadership seat. We expect our engineering leaders to actively drive AI adoption on their teams, not wait to be convinced. Benefits - Rate: $120,000-$140,000 USD annually (contractor), depending on experience - Location: Fully remote - this role is built for remote-first leaders - Flexibility: Structured work hours with reasonable flexibility for life LawnStarter provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. We comply with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment. To apply: https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs/lawnstarter-software-engineering-manager-5
